task.title: Configure URLs, sites, and navigation
task.shortdesc: Use Step 2 to configure homepage and startup behavior, site access, handlers, and managed bookmarks.

prereq.p: Step 2 is open and the schema channel is correct.

context.p: These controls affect which pages users can open and how Firefox starts and navigates. Managed search engines and search suggestions belong to Step 1.

image.alt: Guided Step 2 showing homepage and site access controls.

step.cmd: Open Step 2, URLs, sites, and navigation.

info.p: Expected result: the Step 2 controls are visible without search-engine controls.

step.cmd: Set the homepage or startup behavior required by the profile.

info.p: Expected result: Firefox opens the reviewed starting surface.

step.cmd: Configure permitted or blocked sites, handlers, and managed bookmarks that the profile requires.

info.p: Expected result: related URL and site decisions are reviewed together.

step.cmd: Review the navigation values before moving to security settings.

info.note: Changing a schema-dependent control can make a value invalid for the selected Firefox channel. Use Step 1 for managed search engines or search suggestions.

result.p: The profile defines reviewed homepage, startup, site-access, handler, bookmark, and navigation behavior.

postreq.p: Recovery: if users lose an expected site or navigation path, correct the visible URL or site entry and validate again. Use Step 1 for a managed-search or search-suggestion recovery.
